meta.title: LIS-10747 Ward-Assigned Request No. Reminder
meta.subject: CRS Specimen Acknowledgement - setup-driven reminder popup
meta.author: LIS Team

slides.headline:
Setup-Driven Reminder for
Ward-Assigned Request No.
slides.lede: CRS Specimen Acknowledgement — replace the hardcoded QEH hospital check with control driven by existing loe_control setup, so any hospital can enable the feature without a code change.
slides.footer: Design status: draft  ·  for CP3 review
slides.notes: LIS-10747. Change request against lis-ecpath5-app. The ask: remove the QEH-only hardcode added by LIS-9632 and drive the Lab No. reminder popup from existing loe_control setup instead.

slides.title: How we got here

steps.title: Blood taking within cluster
steps.body: Ward-assigned request numbers from other hospitals (e.g. QEH) became retrievable in KWH CRS.

steps.title: Hardcoded QEH check
steps.body: The Lab No. reminder fired incorrectly for KWH users, so the popup was gated on LisGlobal.hospital == HOSPITAL_QEH.

steps.title: Derive from setup
steps.body: KTH will implement the same feature. The hospital-specific hardcode must give way to setup-driven control.

callout.text: QEH is the only hospital hardcoded today. Rolling the feature out to KTH — or anywhere else — needs a further code change and release for each site.

slides.notes: LIS-8437 made cross-hospital ward-assigned request numbers retrievable. LIS-9632 patched the resulting false reminder with a QEH hardcode. That hardcode is now the blocker for KTH.

slides.title: What the code does today

code.caption: Hospital identity decides the behaviour — not the feature setup.

findings.title: Rollout needs code
findings.body: Every new site adopting ward-assigned request no. requires a source change, build and release.

findings.title: Site logic in the UI layer
findings.body: Hospital identity is embedded in a shared Specimen Acknowledgement component.

findings.title: Setup already says it
findings.body: loe_control already records which hospitals implement the feature — the code just ignores it.

slides.footnote: Note: KWH must keep seeing no reminder — it retrieves other hospitals' ward-assigned request numbers but does not implement the feature locally.
slides.notes: The popup is gated on hospital identity in GcrSpecAckUIComponents.as. Whatever we replace it with must still suppress the reminder at KWH.

slides.title: Proposed logic — driven by loe_control

start.text:
Acknowledge specimen
with no ward-assigned
request no.

fallthrough.label: No
fallthrough.title: No popup
fallthrough.body: Feature not implemented at this hospital

condition.label: Effective condition
condition.note: Both flags are already parsed into dictionaryParam — no new setup required.

slides.notes: Both controls are already parsed as dictionaryParam.isWardPrintReqNumberLabelEnabled and dictionaryParam.isRelabelWardAssignRequestNo, so this is a condition swap in GcrSpecAckUIComponents.as with no new setup or DB work.

slides.title: How each hospital resolves

takeaways.title: Enabling a new site
takeaways.body: Set WARD_PRINT_LABNO_LABEL = 'Y' and leave RELABEL_WARD_ASSIGN_REQ_NO unset. No source change, no release.

takeaways.title: Behaviour preserved
takeaways.body: KWH keeps both controls set to 'Y', so the LIS-9632 fix for cross-hospital retrieval still holds after the hardcode is removed.

slides.notes: The matrix is the regression check: QEH unchanged, KWH still suppressed, KTH enabled by setup alone, all other sites unaffected.

slides.title: Scope of change

steps.title: Remove the QEH hardcode
steps.body: In GcrSpecAckUIComponents.as, drop the LisGlobal.hospital == CommonConstants.HOSPITAL_QEH condition gating the GcrAlertDialogue popup.

steps.title: Gate on dictionary setup
steps.body: Replace it with isWardPrintReqNumberLabelEnabled && !isRelabelWardAssignRequestNo, both already parsed from loe_control into dictionaryParam.

steps.title: Regression on all four cases
steps.body: Verify QEH still prompts, KWH stays silent on cross-hospital retrieval, KTH prompts once configured, and unconfigured sites are unaffected.

sidebar.headline: KTH is next
sidebar.body: KTH will implement ward-assigned request no. under the same setup as QEH. Left as-is, the hardcode forces another hospital-specific patch — and one more for every site after that.

slides.notes: Scope is one condition in one ActionScript file plus regression across the four hospital setup cases. No database or setup-data work.

slides.title: Confirmation needed before CP3 sign-off

asks.q: Confirm KTH loe_control will mirror the QEH ward-print pattern before release.
asks.why: Without matching setup, removing the hardcode does not enable KTH.

asks.q: Is regression across QEH, KWH, KTH, and one unconfigured site the agreed sign-off gate?
asks.why: Locks the matrix as the exit criterion.

asks.q: Any hospital still relying on the QEH hardcode outside loe_control?
asks.why: Rules out a silent behaviour change on cutover.

slides.notes: Concrete asks for the panel — not an open brainstorm. Answers unblock the design write-up.
